pure-announcement.rationale: A documentation landing page rather than a launch, release note or funding announcement; its emptiness is a dimension problem, not an announcement problem.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts covers a Claude Code product overview; there is no substantive overlap to duplicate.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Install commands and surface listings are trivially verifiable against the product.

durability.rationale: Install one-liners, download links and a surface/integration matrix are pure onboarding navigation that churns within months and carries no claim that would remain useful as knowledge.

actionability.rationale: The only actions are installing and launching the product on each surface — product-only steps with no bearing on how anyone builds or decides.

atomicity.rationale: A landing page enumerating five surfaces, three install methods and a table of integration links has no core idea to state in a paragraph.
